Name: Amalek
Summary: Amalek was the son of Eliphaz by his concubine Timna, and the ancestor of the Amalekites.
KeyStory: Amalek's descendants became Israel's bitter enemies, attacking them in the wilderness and for generations after.
RelatedPeople: Eliphaz, Son of Esau; Timna; Esau
LifeLesson: One family's bitterness can echo for generations — which is why forgiveness matters.
